New Class: Demon Hunter

• Unlocks after clearing Floor 6

Legendary Effect Balance Adjustments

Lightning projectile count and range: +50% → +100%

Added +100% damage effect



• Shattering Freeze

Damage against Chilled enemies increased: +25% → +30%



• Ruthless Strike

Damage against Stunned enemies increased: +35% → +50%

⸻



Character Balance Adjustments

• Mage, Brawler: Slight adjustments to hitbox size

Reduced speed, range, and damage of death projectiles

Changed so no projectiles are fired when dying while Stunned

Reduced speed, range, damage, and trigger chance of retaliatory projectiles

UI Fixes

Greater chaos alongside the new items and Legendary effects.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45158330/e1b674391a64675c9f81979adaae909756b6a6bc.png"]6. Balance Adjustments
 • Increased chance for weapons to drop from defeated enemies

notes.title: Week 8 Patch 1.5.1 – Memory-Leak Fix & Performance Boost
notes.content:
Week 8 Patch 1.5.1


✅ Memory-Leak Resolved

• An internal engine bug that caused a memory leak has been fixed by upgrading to the latest engine build

• Overall memory-usage code has been optimized



💡 Expected Results

• Stable memory usage during long sessions

• Fewer crashes caused by running out of memory

• Slight performance gains thanks to extra free RAM

• The new engine may prevent the game from launching on some legacy graphics cards

• Update your GPU drivers and OS to the newest versions

• If the game still will not start, send your GPU model via Discord or e-mail so we can investigate



📋 Updated Specs

• Minimum and recommended PC specs on the Steam page have been refreshed after the engine upgrade



🔧 Bug Fixes

• Wizard – Fixed Basic Attack damage formula and several related Legendary effects that failed to trigger

• Blacksmith – Corrected the display of conditions for raising the Max Enhance Level



⸻

🔮 Next Up – Update 1.6.0

• New Floors 13, 14 and 15

• New bosses and enemies

• New high-tier items

• Equipment with brand-new Legendary effects

• CHAOS DUNGEON difficulty expanded to tiers 11-20



📅 Schedule

• Target launch: 4th week of July

• Content has been in parallel development for about 3 weeks. We appreciate your patience while we polish everything



Thank you!

notes.title: RE-CORE UPDATE 1.5.0 — We Rebuilt the Core
notes.content:
RE-CORE UPDATE 1.5.0


Early Access already brought you shared gold, magnet auto-pickup, an effect-opacity slider, double STASH space, faster Lobby speed—the whole nine yards. But you asked for bigger, deeper changes, so we went back to the studs and rebuilt the core.



⸻

1. Altar of Blessings Reboot

Blessing Levels didn’t carry over between Heroes, so rolling a new character felt rough

We split Class-Exclusive and All-Heroes rows; every skill stat is now global

All your Classes’ skill levels merge into one shared level that powers everyone



2. Account-Wide Floor Progress

New Classes no longer slog from Floor 1

Progress is shared up to your highest cleared Floor, so fresh Heroes jump straight into the fight

Combined with the Altar overhaul, leveling a new Class is a breeze.



3. Pick Your Difficulty

Choose Normal, Hard, or Nightmare when you enter a floor

Cruise on Normal or crank it up for fatter rewards



4. Juicier Curse-Tier Loot in the CHAOS DUNGEON

Each higher Curse tier now adds extra Magic Item Find Chance

Bigger risk, bigger loot—dial in the tier that fits your style



5. Blessed Skills Twice as Common

Blessed skills pop up 2× more often mid-run, making it easier to lock in your dream build



6. Lobby Speed +20%

Movement in the Lobby got a 20 % bump, so it never feels slower than live combat



⸻

🐞 Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue where the legendary affix \[Phoenix] +1 Resurrection Count was not applied correctly after acquiring the Phoenix skill.

Fixed an issue where the Highlight Cursor setting would reset.



⸻

We built RE-CORE so you can level faster, grow Classes easier, and swim in sweeter loot.



⸻

To Our Community



Digging the changes? Hyped for what’s next? Drop us a quick Steam review!

Your feedback keeps the roadmap rolling, and we’re hammering away on the next big update.

Thanks for being awesome.

notes.title: Week 6 Patch 1.4.2 – Curse EXP Fix, Ultra-wide Support Returns, Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Patch 1.4.2


🔧 Fixed EXP loss when the Curse level rises

• An incorrect change was made while increasing Chaos Dungeon difficulty.

• EXP now drops in the correct amount, just as before.



🖥️ Ultra-wide resolution support restored

• We limited resolutions to prevent unexpected UI / gameplay issues, but that was the wrong call.

• The issue has been resolved in another way, and ultra-wide resolutions are available again.

	

🐞 Important bug fix

• In rare cases, equipment became invisible after Equip / Remove.

• Running the game after this patch will make the missing gear reappear.



⸻

Message to the community



We apologize for the inconvenience caused by update 1.4.0.

We’re listening to your feedback and adjusting our direction.

Throughout Early Access, we’ll keep working to improve and update the game.



Thank you.

Hey Survivors,



🔥 Update 1.4.0 is out!

notes.title: Responding to Feedback – Hotfix v1.1.0 Rolls Out Today
notes.content:
May 21 – Hotfix Incoming (v1.1.0)

First off, thank you all for the incredible support and feedback since our Early Access launch.

We’ve carefully reviewed everything you’ve shared with us over the past day, and we’re rolling out a hotfix, Patch v1.1.0 scheduled to go live on May 21 (within the next 8 hours).

⸻

Main Improvements


 Gold is now shared across all characters
 You can now collect gold like EXP, and it will be pulled in with magnets
 Lowered early stage difficulty
 Reduced enemy spawns in certain stages
 Increased item and magnet drop rates
 Reduced screen flash effect on level-up, among other improvements
 Fixed gamepad controller input issues


⸻

The full patch notes for v1.1.0 will be posted once the update goes live.

We hear you loud and clear, and we’re doing our best to respond fast and genuinely.

Huge thanks for all the love and support, it means the world to us.

— Tower of Babel Dev Team
